rules.title: Limits on payments at or prior to tenancy commencement
rules.requirement: No lessor or agent may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than first month's rent, last month's rent at the same rate, a security deposit equal to first month's rent (or an authorized fee in lieu), and the cost for key and lock installation at or prior to tenancy start.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent for security deposit; last month rent equal to first month; fee in lieu max 1 month's rent
rules.summary_plain: You cannot be required to pay more than first and last month's rent, a security deposit equal to one month's rent (or an approved fee instead), and key/lock costs before moving in.
rules.summary_plain_es: No pueden exigirle que pague más que el primer y último mes de renta, un depósito de seguridad igual a un mes de renta (o una tarifa aprobada en lugar de este), y el costo de la llave/cerradura antes de mudarse.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential leases in Massachusetts.
rules.quoted_span: (b) At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following: (i) rent for the first full month of occupancy; and, (ii) rent for the last full month of occupancy calculated at the same rate as the first month; and, (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2); ... (iv) the purchase and installation cost for a key and lock.

rules.title: Security deposit handling and records
rules.requirement: Security deposits must be held in a separate interest-bearing account in a Massachusetts bank, beyond lessor's creditors' claims, with receipts given to tenants. Lessors must maintain detailed records of deposits, damages, and repairs, and provide condition statements to tenants.
rules.summary_plain: Your security deposit must be kept in a separate bank account that earns interest, and your landlord must give you receipts and a written statement of the apartment's condition.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su depósito de seguridad debe mantenerse en una cuenta bancaria separada que genere intereses, y su arrendador debe darle recibos y una declaración escrita del estado del apartamento.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential leases in Massachusetts.
rules.penalty: Tenant may recover three times the interest owed plus court costs and attorney fees if lessor fails to pay interest within 30 days after tenancy ends.
rules.quoted_span: Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth ... Failure to comply with this paragraph shall entitle the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit.
